'''Dirha''' was a gritty industrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was located within the [[Dirha system/Legends|Dirha system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region<ref name="EAOC" /> and lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]<ref name="TEA" /> called the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]],<ref name="SisarRun" /> which connected it to the world of [[Cyborrea/Legends|Cyborrea]]<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[Sespe system/Legends|Sespe system]].<ref name="SisarRun" />

Dirha lay within the sphere of influence of the [[Vosadii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]], a clan of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="LoNH" /> and served as a [[Fuel/Legends|refueling]] point for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that traveled along the hyperlane toward the planets of [[Nimban/Legends|Nimban]] and [[Nar Kreeta]]. After the military forces of the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] species [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] the Hutt Space, Dirha was [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] by members of the species<ref name="TEA" /> between [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] and [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]]<ref name="date" /> in a process called Vongforming.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dirha was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square S-9.<ref name="TEA" />
